جَابِيَةٌ A watering-trough, (S,) or large wateringtrough, (K,) in which water is collected (S) for camels: (TA:) or a watering-trough that collects water: (Er-Rághib, TA:) pl. جَوَابٍ. (S.) Hence, in the Kur [xxxiv. 12], وَجَفَانٍ كَالجَوَابِى [And bowls like watering-troughs, or great wateringtroughs]. (S.) ―
-b2- (assumed tropical:) A company of men. (K, * TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
